text: S9 QA found a P0 in the path set you own (client/src/research/assisted-order/**). The order-request wizard can never satisfy its own submit contract. The server publishes four formAcknowledgments at /api/research/early-access/assisted-orders/config (accuracy, contact_consent, request_notice with scope always; research_use_only when an RUO line is present) and AssistedOrderService.requireAgreements enforces every one at its exact copy-hash version. parseAgreementRequirements in client/src/research/assisted-order/wizard-state.ts:140 reads only body.requiredAgreements (or legacy body.agreements) and drops formAcknowledgments entirely, so those four checkboxes are never rendered, never collected and never submitted. Result: the customer ticks every box the page shows, presses Submit, and the server refuses with 'The accuracy acknowledgment must be confirmed on the current form before submitting. Refresh the page if the form is stale.' No user action can clear it. Proven on a production-shaped local stack: submitting the identical payload WITH the four form pairs added returns HTTP 201 and a real XRR reference, so the rest of your flow is sound. Two smaller items in the same files: api.ts request() sends credentials cookies only and never the member Supabase JWT, so a signed-in member gets 'This request is not authorized.' at step 2 and on the status page with no re-auth affordance (EA-session cookie customers are unaffected, which is why it hides); and every input computes to 14.4px, under the 16px iOS threshold, so Safari zooms on focus at every field. Detail and repro: docs/research-launch/QA-S9-CONVERSION-BLOCKERS.md at SHA c83679ddda91f798fc8c97c9e621971188b2c7f9.
